title: The last major update broke tags in my setup.
creator: derherrmahr
content: I usually browse my emails using saved search folders. Messages in these search folders are losing their tags. I tag the messages, and when I browse them later, the tags are gone. The same happens in regular folders and subfolders. If I browse the regular folders and tag messages while visualizing these folders, the same happens again. Any guesses?
